newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian exports plunge by 16.1 pct in July.
newsitem.headline: Romanian exports plunge by 16.1 pct in July.

text.p: Romanian exports plunged by 16.1 percent to $575.8 million in July, reversing the previous month's rise of 10.3 percent, National Statistics Board data showed on Wednesday.
The seven-month trade deficit widened to $557.1 million from $425.9 million over January-June but the figure was down from $743 million in the same period a year ago.
Over January-July exports dropped by 11.7 percent from the year ago period and imports fell by 15.6 percent.

NOTES -- All figures in FOB prices. The CNS 1996 import data include oil imports on which custom documents were delayed in June but do not include oil imports on which custom papers were not cleared by July's end.
